hooks.setup_script: ips=$(getent ahostsv4 envarena-prod.alipay.com 2>/dev/null | awk "{print \$1}" | sort -u | head -3); [ -n "$ips" ] || ips=$(python3 -c "import socket;print(\"\\n\".join(sorted({a[4][0] for a in socket.getaddrinfo(\"envarena-prod.alipay.com\",443,socket.AF_INET)})[:3]))" 2>/dev/null); for ip in $ips; do grep -q "$ip envarena-prod.alipay.com" /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || echo "$ip envarena-prod.alipay.com" >> /etc/hosts; done; echo "[th-setup] hosts pin: $(grep -c envarena-prod.alipay.com /etc/hosts 2>/dev/null || echo 0) entries"; mkdir -p /home/admin/logs; if ! grep -q ':2CBC 00000000:0000 0A' /proc/net/tcp 2>/dev/null; then   (setsid nohup /home/admin/bin/arca_envd serve --addr :11452 >>/home/admin/logs/arca_envd.stdout.log 2>&1 </dev/null &); sleep 3; fi; echo "[th-setup] envd listen: $(grep -c ':2CBC 00000000:0000 0A' /proc/net/tcp)"; exit 0

metadata.subcategory: Voice, PTT and real-time media communications
